rows.en:
(With my strength as it is now,
I might not be much help...)

(But someday, I'll do my best to be useful
to Frontier, just like everyone else!)

(With my strength as it is now,
I might not be much help...)

(But someday, I'll do my best to be useful
to Frontier, just like everyone else!)

(Walking to school like normal, with nothing
going on, it's like the battles with the Vajra
never even happened...)
(The Vajra showed up right when Sheryl came...)

(They even tried to carry Ranka off, but
what were they really after in the end?)

What's with that face first thing in the morning,
\p?
If you don't hurry, you'll be late.
Huh?! Is it that late already?!
C'mon, let's hurry to the classroom.
Yeah...
rows.notes: x15: the player in many scenes, also Shirakawa (frd_myk_007) and Ranka (nml_rnk_005).

rows.en:
(No matter how much I worry about it,
there's only one thing I need to do...)

(All right! I'll keep working hard with Alto
and the others for peace on Frontier!)

(And walking to school with my friends like this,
enjoying school life...)
(I hope days like these keep going on.)

Geez, how long are you gonna space out?
I'm going on ahead.
H-hey, wait up! Alto...

(Walking to school like normal, with nothing
going on, it's like the battles with the Vajra
never even happened...)

(They even tried to carry Ranka-chan off, but
what were they really after in the end?)

(No matter how much I worry about it,
there's only one thing I need to do...)

(All right! I'll keep working hard with Saotome-kun
and the others for peace on Frontier!)
(I hope days like these keep going on.)
H-hey, wait up! Saotome-kun...
(Phew, today's P.E. was rough...)
Let's go get changed.
I'm all sticky with sweat...
Gary-sensei was brutal today, after all.

And Hilda-sensei got all fired up to match him...
The girls sure got caught in the crossfire too.

It was an unfortunate incident...
Come on, let's hurry.
Phew, that feels so much better...
Hey, \p!!
rows.notes: Pilot Student A; also Ozma in scd_com_106.

rows.en: Huh... What happened?
It showed up...!
rows.notes: deta n da yo (said like a ghost sighting).

rows.en: Showed up? What did?
A uniform thief! Every single girl's uniform is gone!
All of them? Who did it? How...!
Thanks to that, our class is paradise!
P-paradise?
Well, seeing is believing, as they say.
What could it be...
H-huh?
...Please don't stare at me so much...
Heh-heh-heh...!
Wh-why maid outfits...
This was all we had to change into...
Th-this is so embarrassing...
Your order, Master, if you please!
...One of them is way too into this, though...
Hmph, so you lot too, eh...

P-Pinon-chan!
And Claire-senpai too!!

Honestly, what a vile thing for someone to do...
Trying to use my uniform for something indecent...
Uh, I kinda doubt that...
rows.notes: Implying nobody would want Pinon's uniform.

rows.en: ...And what's that supposed to mean?
N-nothing at all, ma'am!!

Either way, the moment we find the culprit,
we'll just have to execute them.
Did your uniform get stolen too, Senpai?

I just got caught in the water when they were
sprinkling the field.
But, how should I put it...
Hmmm...

(I bet this is paradise for people
into that sort of thing...)

Come on, \p-kun.
We're going to go find the culprit.
That's right!!

Soon as we find the rascal, into a maid outfit
they go!
Wh-why do I have to?!
Your luck ran out the moment you were here.
I'm counting on you~
(N-no wayyy!!)
(Phew, today's P.E. was so rough...)
Shall we go get changed?
I'm all sticky with sweat... Ugh, gross~
Hilda-sensei didn't hold back at all today.

And Gary-sensei got all fired up to match her...
Tons of boys got sent to the nurse's office too.
...Is this school really going to be okay...

All of them? Who did it? How...!
Mine was still there, though...
Oh, but the other girls were making a fuss...
...One girl is way too into this...

Come on, \p-san.
We're going to go find the culprit.
Uh, yeah, sure...

uncertain: c02483: 'deta n da yo' (it appeared, ghost-sighting phrasing) rendered 'It showed up...!' so that c02484 'Showed up? What did?' still answers it.
c02503: 'iya, sore wa nai n ja...' read as the player doubting anyone would want Pinon's uniform (Pinon's offended reply follows).
c02506: Claire's 'shokei suru shika nai' kept at full strength: 'we'll just have to execute them'.
c02498/c02514: Hoshimura's maid line and old-fashioned speech ('the rascal', 'into a maid outfit they go').
c02508: 'guraundo no mizumaki ni makikomarechatta' rendered 'caught in the water when they were sprinkling the field'.
